purpose: Q1 transmon coherence landscape over (EJ, EC); Q2 dominant noise channel
known_artifacts: At extreme EJ/EC (~700+) the charge dispersion falls below double-precision resolution (~1e-13 GHz), the first-order derivative underflows to zero and tphi_1_over_f_ng returns inf. Physically correct (charge noise is utterly negligible there) and contributes zero rate to T2, but it is an underflow, not a computed value. Located and verified individually - see data_quality.inf_audit.

Tphi_ng_us in transmon_full_sweep.csv (ng=0) exceeds 1e13 us at every point: the scqubits 1/f formula is first order in df01/dng, which vanishes at ng=0. Harmless in the T2 rate sum; must never be plotted or quoted. See 01_validation.ipynb sec 9.4c.

T2 over this plane correlates with f01 at r = -0.9999 within EJ/EC>=20, so a raw T2 maximum reflects the frequency scaling of dielectric loss rather than design structure. Use the frequency-controlled metrics in section 6.
The unconstrained T2 maximum lies near EJ/EC ~ 0.5, which is a charge qubit, not a transmon. Headline numbers use the EJ/EC >= 20 subset (Koch Eq. 2.13 bound).
units: frequencies GHz; coherence times microseconds (scqubits returns ns, x1e-3)
